name: Skynet IADS
summary: Mission-scripting library that makes SAM sites behave as a networked integrated air defence system.
description:
A Lua library for mission makers. Air defence sites are linked through early-warning radars and command centres, and react as a network rather than individually.

This is loaded **inside a mission** (Do Script File), so there is nothing to install into DCS. Download it from the release page.
